# Hungarian Grand Prix Preview

Mercedes and Ferrari resume their title fight at the Hungaroring as Lewis Hamilton chases consistency against Charles Leclerc's Ferrari, with both teams bringing upgrades that could reshape the championship battle. Aston Martin's major upgrade package arrives with Fernando Alonso targeting a performance leap that could prove decisive for both his future and the team's competitive standing. A strong result here could provide crucial momentum heading into the summer break, with any gains or losses on upgrades immediately magnified across the tight midfield battle.
